headline: Contested Fronts Keep the Base Ledger Moving
war_summary: The latest returns show the war’s chief movement concentrated on a handful of contested fronts, though the tempo is uneven. Lykos Isle remains the busiest sector at 25 base events in 24 hours, with five Colonial-held bases against two Warden-held; fighting and enlistments both accelerated over the latest two-hour comparison. Farranac Coast recorded 12 daily events, including three in the last two hours, and remains divided seven Colonial to four Warden. Fisherman’s Row also saw four events in the latest two hours and 11 across the day, standing eight Warden to one Colonial. Tempest Island has reached 15 daily events, but its most recent two-hour ledger is quiet, with all nine bases Colonial-held. Godcrofts retains an 11-event day amid an eight-to-one Warden majority, while Deadlands’ four events accompany the heaviest casualty totals and an eight-to-three Colonial advantage. Kings Cage, Linn Mercy, Loch Mor, and Weathered Expanse report major casualty activity but no recent base events, leaving their strategic ledger comparatively still.
